title: Particle Autoencoder 4-Corner Reconstruction
intuition: Tier-1 public-API model check: reconstruct four noisy corner Gaussians through deterministic particle-AE routing (recon_mse <= 0.025, mode_agreement >= 0.98) using an explicit reconstruction objective.
failure_mode: Broken encoder/prior routing or unstable optimizer updates degrade reconstruction MSE or scramble corner assignments.
protocol_notes: Tier-1 required public-API model task (64 particles, 2D latent).
